subject: What the coverage tracker's non-clean selector children actually point at
verdict: The rule is not inventing the gap. Every child it flags for the six P1 selector services is blocked or partial because of a feature the live calculator prices and this engine does not implement: remap.constant, a column-form utilization row, or a dependent-selector value derived from the PLC_2.0 aggregation tree. One tracker artifact is real: Amazon WorkSpaces declares six children, two of them (workSpacesThinClient, workSpacesSecureBrowser) have no manifest entry and answer 403 on their definition URL, and the live calculator never offers them, so the parent counted two phantom children as blocked work.

liveEstimate.name: axi-e2e non-clean children probe
liveEstimate.createdHow: Built by hand in the live calculator (Add service flow), saved through the calculator's own Share flow. This client's publisher cannot produce it: the engine fails closed on both services.

rule.before: selector_nonclean = declared children whose row static_class != clean, where a child with no row is scored missing-definition; the parent class collapses any blocked child to blocked:column-form, the parent's own blocker columns stay empty, and the action is the constant string 'Resolve the non-clean children'.
rule.after: A selector is the live calculator's service menu: the parent has no form and no price, and the user configures one child. The parent class is the union of the children the live calculator serves, with classifyStatic's precedence (blocked:subtype > blocked:column-form > partial:column-form > clean). A declared child with no manifest entry is selector_unserved (no live surface, recorded but not scored). selector_blockers names each blocker and the children that carry it, and next_action repeats the concrete child actions.

services.detail: ptsnAudio has five column forms whose primary key (NumberType or CallType) has no row at all: the value comes from remap.constant ({"NumberType":"DDI"}, {"CallType":"SMA Local"}, ...). The override map rejects a user-supplied NumberType with INVALID_SPEC (valid selectors: FromCountry), so the constant is the only source of the primary key. The engine throws UNSUPPORTED_INPUT for remap.constant before pricing.
services.liveProof: The live matcher drops a constant-valued selector from the label match (bundle offset 1469061: `if(u&&u.constant)for(const n in u.constant)if(u.constant[n]===t)return null`) and the aggregation fetch filters rows by the same constant (offset 1464986).

services.detail: Each node child has a column-form row of type utilization with a selectorId (Utilization / Running Mode). The engine rejects it: UNSUPPORTED_INPUT columnFormIPM "masterNode_generated_0" has a "utilization" row, which is not implemented yet.
services.liveProof: The live component exports hours from a utilization row: `if(t&&"utilization"===t.type&&"object"==typeof r&&r!==null){const{totalHour:e}=Object(q.a)(r);r=Number(e)||0}` (offset 2890391), with the component default `utilization:{defaultValue:{unit:"100",selectedId:"%Utilized/Month"}}` (offset 2877843).

services.cause: input:utilization (2 and 3 per child) and remap.constant
services.detail: Both children use the utilization input subtype, which the w1-utilization branch implements and this base does not; the coverage row now reports blocked:subtype instead of blocked:column-form. Both also carry a component-level remap.constant ({"Product Name":"Blu Age Runtime"} / {"Product Name":"Enterprise Server"}), so they stay blocked after utilization lands.

The three Personal/Core children have a utilization row (Billing option, default {unit:"730",selectedId:"Monthly"}) and dependent selectors; workSpacesPools has only dependent selectors. Two declared children are not services: the manifest has no entry for them, their definition URLs answer 403, and the live page offers exactly four children (WorkSpaces Pools is disabled in US East (Ohio), which matches the tracker's runtime unknown-region).
services.liveProof: https://calculator.aws/#/createCalculator/WorkSpaces shows WorkSpaces Personal, WorkSpaces Core Bundles, WorkSpaces Core Managed Instances and a disabled WorkSpaces Pools. No Thin Client and no Secure Browser card exists. Screenshot receipts/screenshots/probe-workspaces-children.png.

services.detail: Pipeline, Resolution, Bit Rate, Video Quality, Frame Rate and Reserve Type are all dependent rows with no default for most cards. mediaLiveInput1 prices at defaults (7.30/month) and mediaLiveAnywhereChannel is clean, but mediaLiveOutput1 fails closed: MISSING_PRICE for {Pipeline, Output, Video Quality, Resolution, Frame Rate, Bit Rate, Reserve Type}.

Video Quality Setting, Video Resolution, Video Frame Rate and Normalization_Ratio have defaultValue "" and a dependent list. In the live UI they resolve to Single pass / 4K / <=30fps / 4, and Normalization_Ratio multiplies the metered minutes. This engine skips the empty values and cannot match an aggregation row: MISSING_PRICE. The same component also exposes a second, separate gap: remap.keyValue is applied in the wrong direction, see engineGaps.

evidence.what: remap.keyValue maps a price token (key) to a UI value (value), not the other way round
evidence.code: index path builder (offset 1466154): m=p.map(e=>{let t=h[e];if(d&&d.keyValue)for(const r in d.keyValue)if(d.keyValue[r]===t){t=r;break}return t})
evidence.meaning: h is the user value; the key r is used as the selector token for the index path. Definition {"AVC/H.264":"AVC"} plus aggregation Video Codec "AVC/H.264" confirms it.

evidence.what: The label matcher uses the same direction
evidence.code: offset 1469061: if(u&&u.keyValue)for(const n in u.keyValue)if(u.keyValue[n]===t)return n;
evidence.meaning: A UI value equal to a map value is replaced by the map key before substring matching against the price set labels.

evidence.what: A dependent selector's value is derived from the aggregation tree, not from the user's untouched input
evidence.code: offset 1469061: const r=s.find(t=>t.selectorId===e&&!!t.dependent);if(r){const n=[].concat(r.dependent,e),i=n.map(e=>d[e]).filter(Boolean);if(n.length===i.length){const r=b(f[e],i);t!==r&&(t=r)}}  with  function b(e,t){const r=t.shift();return Object.keys(e).includes(r)?0===t.length?r:b(e[r],t):Object.keys(e)[0]}
evidence.meaning: The live engine walks the aggregation selector tree with the parent values and takes the nested leaf, so an empty dependent row still gets a token.

evidence.what: remap.constant filters aggregation rows and drops the constant selector from the label match
evidence.meaning: Constant values are a filter over candidate rows, plus a token that is not required in the label.

evidence.what: A column-form utilization row exports hours per month
evidence.meaning: The row's object value becomes the billed hour count, so it is a pricing input, not display text.

engineGaps.what: remap.keyValue is inverted and never applied to the aggregation match. src/engine/column-form.ts does remap[primaryValue] ?? primaryValue (UI value -> map value) while the live engine maps UI value -> map key. src/data/column-form.ts matchAggregation ignores remap entirely and requires exact equality with the raw UI value.
engineGaps.proof: realTimeDocumentTranslation fails at runtime with MISSING_PRICE: no PLC_2.0 price set matches Basic - Text, HTML. The definition is remap.keyValue {"Basic":"Basic - Text, HTML"} with rows [{FileType, default Basic}]; the live token for UI value Basic is Basic. analysis/W2_REPEATABLE_ROWS_REPORT.md attributed this service's missing-price to region availability, which is wrong.
engineGaps.scope: 25 definitions carry a non-identity remap.keyValue. realTimeDocumentTranslation was the only one scored clean while failing at runtime; the tracker now blocks it. The mirror case, where the default value is a remap value so the live engine substitutes and this one does not, is listed in mirrorCase: all 6 definitions are already blocked and all fail with missing-price.

trackerCorrection.rule: remap.keyValue-direction: a pricing selector's default value is itself a remap key, so this engine substitutes the map value (a form label) for the token while the live engine keeps the value. The check is static and needs no network.
trackerCorrection.whyItMatters: A clean label that errors is worse than a blocked one because it is trusted.

engineGaps.what: Support a row of type utilization that has a selectorId: read the {unit, selectedId} object, export hours, and use the selectedId as the price token. Today the object is stringified to "[object Object]" and the row is then rejected.
Support remap.constant: filter candidate price rows whose selector is absent or equal, supply the constant value as the primary token, and drop it from the label match.
Derive dependent selector values from the aggregation tree (live function b / v) and tolerate rows whose dependent selectors are absent instead of skipping them and demanding an exact match.
